# Item use

`cinnabar:extension/item-use@0.1.0`

Opt-in item-use policy; requires the explicit item-use grant.

**Grants:** `item_use`.

## Functions

<a id="pulse-use"></a>

### `pulse-use`

```wit
pulse-use: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

One item-use press edge for the next gameplay tick, only while the physical use control
is held. It skips only the client's use repeat delays: the rearm after an air use and the
hold-off after an attack. Block interaction, item cooldowns and tick admission, at most
one air use per tick from a hotbar slot, still apply. Requires a gameplay frame. An active
action filter receives it as a repeat.
